data.title: Kindergeld decision for your daughter Marlene
data.summary: The Familienkasse Musterrhein (Kindergeldnummer 355FK207441) informed Anton Musterschmidt that it has set Kindergeld for his daughter Marlene (born 14 August 2006) at €255.00 per month starting April 2025, because she has been studying at a Hochschule since the 2025 summer semester, with entitlement lasting until she turns 25.
data.explanation: This letter grants you monthly child benefit (Kindergeld) of €255.00 for Marlene starting April 2025, because she is now a university student; it will continue until she turns 25 as long as she stays enrolled. You must tell the Familienkasse if she drops out of or interrupts her studies, since that can end the entitlement. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline for that. Keep this letter, as Kindergeld can matter for your tax return. Otherwise, no action is needed now — the payments should simply start.
data.tax_note: Kindergeld can affect your income tax return through the Günstigerprüfung (comparison with the Kinderfreibetrag child tax allowance), so keep this decision letter with your tax records.

items.title: Notify the Familienkasse if Marlene stops or interrupts her studies
items.action: Tell the Familienkasse Musterrhein if your daughter drops out of or interrupts her university studies.
items.quote: Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Marlene das Studium abbricht oder unterbricht.

items.title: Object to the Kindergeld decision (Einspruch) if you disagree
items.action: If you disagree with this decision, file an objection (Einspruch) with the Familienkasse Musterrhein in writing, electronically via ELSTER, or to the record, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Wer mit dieser Festsetzung nicht einverstanden ist, kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterrhein erheben – schriftlich, elektronisch über ELSTER oder zur Niederschrift.
